## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally
- [ ] Folder name equals `name` in frontmatter
- [ ] `description` says what the skill does **and** when to use it
- [ ] `metadata.version` bumped and `## Changelog` updated (for changes to an existing skill)
- [ ] No secrets, destructive commands, hidden network calls or obfuscated code
- [ ] Irreversible actions (send, delete, publish, pay) require user confirmation
- [ ] I did **not** edit `registry/skills.json`
- [ ] I have the right to publish this under the license declared in the frontmatter
